entities.name: Harvesttide Festival
entities.description: An ancient harvest festival on Innistrad celebrating life and community, revived to restore the dawn.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the festival takes place.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
aliases: the witches of the Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: Coven of witches who lead the festival ritual.

entities.name: Leinore
entities.description: Oversees festival preparations as Autumn Sovereign.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Alpha of a howlpack of werewolves who attack the festival.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who fights Tovolar.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers who help the witches.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who helps defend and carries Arlinn.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who delivers the Moonsilver Key to Katilda.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Key needed for the ritual, taken by Olivia.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who interrupts the ritual and takes the Key.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: Member of Arlinn's wolf pack who stays apart.

entities.name: Eternal Night
entities.description: Endless night caused by the Eldrazi in the moon.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Ancient, never-turning structure beneath which the festival and ritual take place.

entities.name: Kurbis
entities.description: Geist said to have been one of the first Harvesttide sovereigns.

events.summary: As the Eldrazi in the moon bring longer nights and the werewolves go mad, citizens turn to the Dawnhart Coven, whose leader Katilda proposes reviving the festival.
events.quote: The leader of the coven, Katilda , proposed to revive the festival.

events.summary: Leinore is asked to oversee preparations as Autumn Sovereign, and people gather from all over Kessig.
events.quote: Leinore was asked to oversee the preparations for the festival as "Autumn Sovereign"

events.summary: Tovolar's werewolves attack the barrier around the festival, and the Gatewatch helps the witches.
events.quote: In human form, hundreds of werewolves attacked the magical barrier put up around the festival.

events.summary: Teferi slows the sunset while Adeline and Chandra organize defense and Kaya delivers the Moonsilver Key to Katilda.
events.quote: Knowing that they would be overpowered when it became night, Teferi slowed the sunset.

events.summary: Arlinn faces Tovolar and changes form when night falls.
events.quote: When the night finally fell, Arlinn changed form.

events.summary: Arlinn feigns surrender then overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with his pack.
events.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar with a death grip around his chest.

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key, leaving the ritual unfinished and the Eternal Night a fact.
events.quote: but Olivia Voldaren appeared to interrupt the ritual again and took the Key with her.

relations.quote: The leader of the coven, Katilda , proposed to revive the festival.

relations.note: fought and tried to recruit her
relations.quote: Arlinn and Tovolar fought and both got severe wounds.
The withches received help from a group of planeswalkers known as the the Gatewatch .
